gloss: no way; you're kidding; are you serious?

definitions.gloss: no way; you're kidding; that can't be true
definitions.explanation: A casual exclamation expressing disbelief or shock. Literally 'that's a lie, right?' Used when hearing something surprising or hard to believe.

examples.japanese: {嘘|うそ}だろ！⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: No way! I can't believe it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧？{嘘|うそ}だろ。
examples.english: You failed the exam? You're kidding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧だ⟦って→って：29146_tte⟧？{嘘|うそ}だろ、⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にしてた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: Tomorrow's game is cancelled? No way — I was looking forward to it the whole time.

notes:
An extremely common casual expression in spoken Japanese. The tone can range from genuine shock to mild surprise. Considered masculine-leaning; female speakers more often use ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧でしょ or ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧！

FORMS:
- {嘘|うそ}だろ: casual masculine (plain)
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧でしょ: slightly softer, used by both genders
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧でしょう: more polite
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧！: short exclamation (very common among women)
- ⟦マジ→マジ：04744_maji⟧で？: "seriously?" (similar function, very casual)

USAGE:
Despite containing ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ (lie), this expression does not accuse anyone of lying. It simply expresses the speaker's disbelief at surprising information.
